audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that require deterministic parsing and generation of MSG, CFB, and EML email formats without external dependencies.

capabilities.text: Read, build, and write generic Compound File Binary containers directly through `cfb_reader`, `cfb_storage`/`cfb_stream`, and `cfb_writer`, working with file paths, in-memory streams, or raw byte buffers.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB access

capabilities.text: Parse and reconstruct the raw MSG directory/stream structure with `msg_reader`, `msg_document`, and `msg_writer`, including an optional strict-validation mode surfaced through `validation_issues()`.
capabilities.title: Low-level MSG document model

capabilities.text: Create, edit, save, and reload Outlook-style messages through `mapi_message`, setting the subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity, or reaching arbitrary MAPI properties via `set_property()`/`get_property_value()`.
capabilities.title: High-level message authoring

capabilities.text: Add To/Cc/Bcc recipients with `add_recipient()`, attach regular files from byte buffers or streams with `add_attachment()`, and nest a full `mapi_message` as an embedded-message attachment with `add_embedded_message_attachment()`.
capabilities.title: Recipients and attachments

capabilities.text: Save an in-memory `mapi_message` to `.eml` and load `.eml` back into a `mapi_message`, both through the library's own MIME engine, with no external MIME dependency.
capabilities.title: MSG/EML interoperability

limitations.text: No SMTP, IMAP, POP3, or other network mail-protocol support — this library reads and writes MSG, CFB, and EML containers and messages already on disk, in memory, or in a stream; it is not a mail client or transport library.
No PST (Outlook Personal Folders) archive support — only single MSG-format messages and generic CFB containers are supported, not multi-message PST stores.

Only a curated subset of MAPI properties has a dedicated named accessor on `mapi_message`; every other property must be read and written through the generic `get_property_value()`/`set_property()` pair.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic, byte-level processing of Outlook MSG and CFB email containers without third-party dependencies, supporting both low-level structural access and high-level message authoring.
Provides a unified API for reading and writing MSG, CFB, and EML formats, including MSG-to-EML and EML-to-MSG conversion through a built-in MIME engine.
Supports both low-level CFB/MSG structure inspection and high-level message authoring via `mapi_message`, allowing fine-grained control or rapid development as needed.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for C++ is a C++17 library for reading and writing binary email containers and messages — Compound File Binary (CFB) containers, Outlook MSG documents, and RFC 5322 / MIME EML files — with deterministic, byte-level output and no third-party library dependency of its own.

uncertainties: The exact set of MAPI properties supported by `common_message_property_id` and `property_type_code` is not listed in the facts.
Whether `mapi_message::load_from_eml()` supports all RFC-compliant MIME constructs or only a subset is not specified.
The behavior of `strict` mode in `msg_reader`/`msg_document` constructors is not detailed beyond the presence of `validation_issues()`.
The byte-level determinism guarantees (e.g., ordering, padding, encoding) for output formats are not explicitly defined.
The scope of `cfb_reader`/`cfb_writer` for non-MSG use cases (e.g., general OLE2 files) is not clarified beyond MSG support.
Whether embedded-message attachments preserve full MAPI property fidelity when reloaded is not stated.
The threading model or thread-safety guarantees of `mapi_message` and related classes are not provided.
The versioning policy for the public API surface (`PUBLIC_API.md`) and compatibility across releases is not detailed.

workflows.name: Read MSG file subject
workflows.text: Open an MSG file as a binary stream and extract the subject using `mapi_message::from_stream(stream, strict).subject()`.

workflows.name: Create and save message
workflows.text: Create a message with `mapi_message::create()`, set subject/body/sender, add recipients/attachments, and save as MSG or EML using `save()` or `save_to_eml()`.

workflows.name: Inspect low-level MSG structure
workflows.text: Parse MSG files using `msg_reader` and `msg_document` to walk the underlying CFB directory/stream structure and inspect raw storage and stream entries.

workflows.name: Build and run examples
workflows.text: Enable `ASPOSE_EMAIL_FOSS_BUILD_EXAMPLES` in CMake to build CLI examples in `examples/` that demonstrate MSG/EML reading, writing, and inspection workflows.

workflows.name: Run tests
workflows.text: Build and run three CTest-registered test executables (`aspose_email_foss_cfb_tests`, `aspose_email_foss_msg_tests`, `aspose_email_foss_public_tests`) without external test frameworks.
